payload.title: LLM logprob comparators: Llama, Qwen and Gemma via option-token logprobs
payload.description: The slow-thinking comparator without an API bill: transformers last-token logits on every device, mlx-lm logprobs on Mac, llama.cpp n_probs for one GGUF across Metal, CPU and CUDA. Qwen is the Chinese-trained comparator the nationality axis of batch 2 needs.
